keyLimits.en: 5 social profiles, 1 user per workspace, unlimited AI content generation, 10 content categories, analytics up to 3 months.
10 social profiles, 1 user per workspace, advanced analytics, hashtag organizer, post approval, CSV uploads, 2-year data history.
25 social profiles, 5 workspaces, 3 users per workspace, export reports, internal notes, bulk editing, 2-year data history.

cautions.en: A visible promo (code SBDAY2026, 50% off monthly plans for 3 months, expiring around June 10) was excluded from the plan prices above per pricing rules; only the regular list prices are recorded.
Agency-tier plans (Pro50/Pro100/Pro150, $179-$449/month) exist above Pro for larger profile counts but are not recorded here as they exceed the target audience's needs.

capabilities.en: Schedules and publishes social media posts across multiple platforms with content categorization for organizing post types.
Evergreen content recycling: automatically re-shares and re-queues older posts based on content categories.
AI-assisted content generation included unlimited on all paid plans.

limitations.en: No free plan; only a 14-day trial before payment is required.
Entry Bootstrap plan is limited to a single user per workspace, restricting collaboration without upgrading or buying add-on seats.

reason.en: Widely used social media scheduling tool targeting the same solo/small team audience.
Social scheduling and analytics platform competing on similar pricing tiers.
Budget social media scheduler often compared directly to SocialBee.

unknowns: Exact list of supported social platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, etc.) was not itemized in the source page excerpt retrieved.
Mobile app availability (iOS/Android) not confirmed in this session.
